expectations.evidence: Short flag names (-d, -c, -ext), idiomatic error handling (if err != nil), channel-based concurrency, fmt.Fprintf to stderr, time.AfterFunc for debounce. Flat structure, no over-abstraction.
Comment '300ms felt right after testing with vim swapfiles' — pragmatic over precise. Simple string-splitting for command parsing. No complex arg validation. 'fwatch' as module name — quick/informal.
main.go is flat/procedural, watcher package is structured with methods. Different writing styles that relate naturally — main uses the watcher interface cleanly.
Polling-based approach instead of fsnotify (pragmatic choice with reasoning). Zero external dependencies. Simple debounce via time.AfterFunc rather than a debounce library.

defaultDebounce constant defined but flag also has hardcoded '300' default (slight redundancy). Comment about vim swapfiles (specific testing history). Extension filter added as extra feature showing organic growth.
